Title: Service Fabric Mesh preview - spring update for features in development

Body.Content:
Mesh is being updated to include the following:

  • an integration with Managed Identities
  • support for Windows Server 2019 and 1809 containers
  • improved monitoring for applications

With this release, billing will be enabled at a 50% discount since the service is still in preview.

Learn more about Service Fabric Mesh.
